message.content:
Based on the search results, Jay Ellis's height is reported differently across sources:

- **6 feet 3 ½ inches (191.8 cm)** according to Celeb Heights (as cited by one source)
- **6 feet 2 ½ inches (189 cm)** according to Who's Dated Who
- **6 feet 2 inches** according to MrDustbin

The most commonly cited height appears to be around **6 feet 2 inches to 6 feet 3 ½ inches** (approximately 189-192 cm). The variation may be due to different measurement methods or whether shoe height is included. Celeb Heights, which specializes in celebrity height measurements, lists him at the taller end of 6'3½".

Sources:
1. https://sfp.mlga.ek.gov.ng/how-tall-is-the-insecure-actor-and-5-facts-about-him.html
2. https://www.whosdatedwho.com/dating/jay-ellis
3. https://www.mrdustbin.com/us/jay-ellis/
